# Chapter 5: Non-democracies and Democratic Backsliding

## 5.1: Understanding Non-Democratic Regimes

::: callout-note
### Learning Objectives

By the end of this section, you will be able to:

- Classify the major types of authoritarian and non-democratic regimes.
- Explain the mechanisms authoritarian rulers use to maintain political control and legitimacy.
- Analyze the causes and institutional patterns of democratic backsliding.
:::
